Subject: TOM: Q: Ousting Timing and Fame
Date: 21 Dec 1994 18:56:58 GMT
Message-ID: <3d9tpq$6...@redwood.cs.scarolina.edu>

Hypothetical situation re: timing of ousting and Fame:

I'm in a 3-player game of Jyhad.
My Prey ("B") has 1 pool left.
Her Prey (my Predator, "C") has 3 pool left.
I have X pool left, where X sufficiently large :-)

I have a vampire (e.g. Giuliano Vincenzi) with fortitude and two blood.
I play Fame on Giuliano Vincenzi.

Giuliano Vincenzi bleeds my prey, using Day Operation to remain unblocked.
My Prey ("B") loses her last pool.
Giuliano Vincenzi (as per Day Operation) goes to torpor after the action.
Fame causes my prey to lose 3 pool when the vampire, Giuliano Vincenzi, goes
into torpor.

Q: who loses the 3 pool? My old, ousted prey "B", or my new prey "C"?

(Essentially: is my prey ousted during the action, immediately after, or
at the end of the turn? And, does it matter?)
